dimensions.assessment: Affects federal officials responsible for administering sanctions lists and individuals or entities subject to those lists.
dimensions.evidence: the Federal official responsible for administering such list shall notify the Federal officials responsible for administering the other lists

dimensions.assessment: Mandates administrative review and reporting procedures across federal agencies regarding existing sanctions lists.
dimensions.evidence: shall initiate a review regarding whether such individual or entity warrants inclusion on such other lists.

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative agency reviews and reports with no explicit spending figures stated.
Imposes new inter-agency review, notification, and reporting requirements across multiple federal departments.
dimensions.evidence: each Federal agency maintaining a list described in subsection (d) shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees a report

dimensions.assessment: Imposes ongoing inter-agency review requirements and a one-year reporting deadline.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the enactment of this Act, each Federal agency... shall submit... a report

importance_detail.rationale: Requires federal agencies maintaining certain sanctions lists to notify other agencies and conduct reviews on whether listed individuals or entities should be added to other lists.
